notes.title: Update 1.1.0! New arenas, new items and a free Demo!
notes.notes:
It's about time we added some content, isn't it? You've waited long enough!

Patch 1.1

🔸 12 new arenas to vary the pleasures and intensify the battles

🔸 Redesigned arenas with new contours

🔸 New bonuses:

💖 A healing bonus to keep you in the action
❄️ A bonus to slow down your opponents and gain an advantage
💥 A bonus that makes your stars explosively dangerous

🔸 Improvements and fixes:

🕹️ Reworked pause menu
💡 Light settings for an even more immersive atmosphere
✨ VFX optimization
🔊 Sound and expulsion adjustments for a more punchy feel

🔥 But that's not all... A free demo is now available 🔥
So give it a try and share it with your friends. It's the perfect opportunity to let as many people as possible discover the game.

🌟 Thank you for your support, and see you soon in the arena! 🌟

Don't forget to leave a review and share your experience. Your feedback is crucial to the evolution of the game!
